title: Sled Dog Race
tagline: Pace your team, call the trail, care for every dog.
description: Dog sled racing from the snowy north of Canada and the United States. See the trail from the side, drive six dogs with one thumb, brake on the downhills, call Gee and Haw and look after the team at every checkpoint. Trail Cup, endless Trail Run, Practice, Learn drills, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Slide the pace lever from Walk to Gallop: faster tires the dogs.
Tap Brake on steep downhills and lift it at the bottom.
Tap Gee (right) or Haw (left) when the call marker lights up.
At the checkpoint give water, snacks, paws, rest and praise.
Finish ahead of the rivals with a care score of 65% for the Care Award.
